{{Quote|Shoran's scouts have discovered an array of Trade Federation listening posts.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoransScouts.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''listening array''' belonging to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was built on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] there between the corporation and the [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rightful]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. The array was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[Battle droid/Legends|droid]] [[LUH-989]] and was guarded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, advanced [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. It was [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]] by the Wookiee [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==Description==
{{Quote|They are wary of us, keeping tabs on our progress.|Qui-Gon Jinn, on the purpose of the listening array|audio=WaryFeds.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] company operated a listening array on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on their rival [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]. The array was located on a [[Beach/Legends|beach]] surrounded by a [[Water/Legends|river]] that stretched past its western and northern sides. A thick [[Forest/Legends|forest]] covered the eastern side. The array was only accessible by land from a shallow path through the river on the north. The other side of the river had three [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] to alert the Federation of anyone approaching the listening array.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Listening_array_sentry_posts.png|thumb|left|300px|Three sentry posts were placed at the entrance to the listening array.]]
The array consisted of six [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] for listening in on Wookiee communications. One was placed on elevated ground near the entrance and guarded by a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] and two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. Four transmitters occupied the lower middle section of the array, with one adjacent to the river and the other three in a triangular arrangement closer to the forest, where the ground was more elevated. Two B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and two advanced [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] guarded the transmitters. The last transmitter was placed on a strip of land that jutted out into the river, and was guarded by another droideka. Various [[Tree/Legends|trees]] grew throughout the array.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Chewbacca suggests we show them our progress by destroying their listening array.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ChewieSuggests.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Attack_on_the_listening_array.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Wookiees destroy the transmitters.]]
The listening array was built at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> as part of the Trade Federation's [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] attempt on Alaris Prime. The [[Droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[LUH-989]] was placed in [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the array, keeping track of the progress of the rightful Wookiee colonists, with whom the Federation was engaged in a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]].<ref name="GB" />

After an [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attack]] ordered by LUH-989 on the [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] of the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] failed, [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] from the [[Shoran's camp|camp]] of another Wookiee colonist, [[Shoran]], discovered the listening array. One heavy [[bowcaster trooper]] from Shoran's camp entered the array and fought the droids at its entrance, but the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. With the guidance of his [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Chewbacca gathered<ref name="GB" /> a group of between eight and thirty Wookiees<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and&mdash;together with Shoran&mdash;marched towards the listening array and destroyed all six transmitters along with every droid there.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The listening array was first mentioned in the [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="Prima" />&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The array appears in the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, titled "Allies and Jedi."<ref name="GB" />
